email.subject: Shoreline Works Dentistry: a couple of quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Shoreline Works Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next dentist. And the site isn't set up for mobile, which is how most people are finding you in the first place.

It also doesn't list your hours, and the footer still shows an old date, both of which make people second-guess calling.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's going on and what I'd change, no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
